_help: Raise "at" (YYYY-MM-DD) whenever you change anything; the app only takes a newer pack. gold.rates are taka a bhori (BAJUS). items maps an item id to its five price points, cheapest to top, e.g. "v_photo_biy": [7500, 20000, 55000, 110000, 250000]; seen maps an item id to the "Prices seen" note. Item ids are listed in README.md. partners lists the decorators shown in "Ask a decorator for a quote": {"name": "...", "wa": "8801XXXXXXXXX", "bn": "...", "area": "...", "note": "...", "events": ["biye", "holud"]}; only name and wa are required.
